title: Transportation Engine Repair and Machining
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: TRANSPORTATION ENGINE REPAIR AND MACHINING CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
outcomes: Demonstrate basic technical skills used by engine machinist, in the areas of tool selection, use and maintenance, practical measuring skills, nomenclature, systems function, systems service, minor repair procedures, and major repair complexities.
Demonstrate the skills to prepare and take the Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) A1 exam through preforming diagnostic analysis and repair on cylinder heads and engine blocks.

Demonstrate the skills to prepare and take the Automotive Engine Rebuilders Association (AERA) exam in the ares of cylinder head machining and engine block machining by preforming machining tasks on cylinder heads and engine blocks.
careers: Automotive, Bus, Train, and Marine Machining field

notes: The catalog prints AUTO 51.20; the closed list stores AUTO 51.2 (Automotive Technical Skills, 3 units). Treated as the same course, not a catalog addition.

The section at the top of page 70 (total 34 units, AUTO 50B, 52.36, 52.44, etc.) belongs to a preceding engine performance/emissions certificate and was not read.
